messages.subject: Ouput and refresh Rstan 2.4
parts:
Hi. 

I used Rstan 2.3 without problems: I suppressed the output by using refresh=-1 in my loops (I'm doing 5000 replications for 2 models, I really don't want the output of all).
But since I updated (upgraded?) to 2.4, I get the output, regardless of refresh=-1.

Same area, different issue: If I want a refresh every, say, 100 iteraties, I now get a new line for each one, where before it would just update the last refresh.
So now I get:
SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'ar_stan1' NOW (CHAIN 3).

Iteration:    1 / 2000 [  0%]  (Warmup)
Iteration:  100 / 2000 [  5%]  (Warmup)
Iteration:  200 / 2000 [ 10%]  (Warmup)
Iteration:  300 / 2000 [ 15%]  (Warmup)
Iteration:  400 / 2000 [ 20%]  (Warmup)

In stead of:
SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'ar_stan1' NOW (CHAIN 3).
Iteration:  400 / 2000 [ 20%]  (Warmup)

I also update R to 3.1.1, I had 3.0.2.

So, my questions are:
1. Can I get Rstan to not give ANY output if there is no error, as formerly with refresh=-1?
2. Can I get Rstan to update the refresh line in stead of give me a new one every time?

I hear about the sink() option, and will try it if the answer to the above is no. However, I work with several models at once, soms frequentistic, so I would like to be able to see messages from other models.

Thank you in advance.
